measurement_boundaries.cpu: Resolved sampled CPU stack weights in the single launched sifr process; use table-declared units, normalize time weights to ms only when declared. Aggregate identical source families once; avoid counting parent inclusive weights twice. No conversion to instructions or claimed saved-cost fractions.
measurement_boundaries.allocations: Per-process allocated/freed/live heap bytes and event counts at trace timestamps; last live set before process termination, not post-exit zero. This is not ru_maxrss, physical footprint or a leak proof.
measurement_boundaries.control_use: Shared executable-startup negative control only; do not subtract its short trace as an exact baseline correction.
measurement_boundaries.coverage_limit: Prioritize the common19.4B check/diagnostic startup path. No new formatter/LSP target or canonical suite. LSP-specific engine/snapshot residency and formatter excess remain separately mapped and unquantified; no claim one trace clears them.
measurement_boundaries.acceptance: Usable per-process identity, both check traces contain symbol-resolved bootstrap/lowering stacks, allocations/lifetimes export with declared units, expected check/version exit0, no changed input, and the same leading family in both check traces. If not, stop rather than append samples.

fixed_limits.bounded_storage_checks: Before and after each process and every5s only within owned output during recording; stop before launching another process if capacity limit breached. A process-local file-size ceiling and the owned-directory monitor bound exports/trace growth; never clean another target.
fixed_limits.first_failure: Hash/source mismatch, permission/UI requirement, unavailable combined instrument, timeout, storage boundary, nonzero target/recorder/export, missing units or insufficient symbolization: stop immediately; no retry, alternate profiler, added launch or new build. The first control is the setup-capability discriminator; no separate smoke target.
fixed_limits.cleanup: Each future recorder/target uses an owned process group with tracked descendant identities; at deadline stop recorder, TERM only owned descendants/group, then KILL only survivors within30s; wait/reap and verify absence before next process. Preserve incomplete trace and failure receipt; do not reset any prior failure counter. Retain successful source/trace/exports with inventory; no automatic deletion of predecessor or diagnostic evidence.
